messages:
akshat: Autoscaler alarm — scale-up attempts failing in ap-southeast1 for the last 6m. Pods stuck Pending (GPU requests). cc @maria @josh

maria: Seeing Provisioner backlog / capacity-exhausted errors in the controller logs. Cloud capacity report shows "GPUs available: 0" for ap-southeast1. Also a bunch of spot evictions reported. :warning:

deploy-bot: ALERT: autoscaler-scaleup-failure count=42 window=5m last_error=ProvisionerBacklog region=ap-southeast1

josh: Curious — node CPU averages ~18% but queue depth and backend RT spike. Feels like a noisy signal (KV cache miss storm) + scheduling constraints (AZ affinity).

laura: Did we push any nodeAffinity / topologySpread changes for inference pool yesterday? I recall an AZ pin for the kernel-canary run.

maria: Yes — kernel-canary nodepool got an AZ affinity tweak. Rolling that back now. Also manually bumped the MIG desired size +8 to give the pending pods something to schedule onto.

akshat: Autoscaler was effectively poisoning itself: provisioning delay > scale_cooldown so it kept oscillating (scale-down then back-up). I increased autoscaler.cooldown to 180s and disabled predictive-burst for the pool.

josh: Plan: route traffic off the region while we stabilize. Shifting 35% ap-southeast1 -> eu-west1 and 15% -> us-east1 for 30m. Triggered traffic job: 
```
curl -sX POST https://router.internal/shift -d '{"from":"ap-southeast1","weights":{"eu-west1":0.35,"us-east1":0.15}}'
```

maria: Quick metrics update after the MIG bump + routing: pending_pods down from ~420 -> 14; p95 latency still elevated on heavy prompt paths, p99 ~1.3s (was 0.9s pre-spike). New nodes GPU util ~65%.

laura: Filing incident ticket + adding runbook steps: rollback AZ affinity, increase cooldown, manual MIG bump, traffic-shift. Follow-ups: dig into provisioner queueing, cloud-provided capacity report for AP regions, and consider a small pre-warm reserved pool for peak hours. @oncall please ack :eyes:
